label: Formal fact: with 'GENUS_1' in the quarta via's GENUS_1 principle…, via strict GENUS_1 reading fails
meaning: Countermodel, from no premises: if 'in aliquo genere' in ST I q.2 a.3 meant a strict genus, the quarta via would not reach a cause of being, because Aristotle's premises make being no strict genus, so the strict principle never applies at being. So the via needs the broad sense.
